verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an MCP server giving AI agents programmatic access to the Admin API, a CLI for managing flags from the terminal, and an Admin API covering full flag CRUD — combined with Feature Change Requests providing a documented four-eyes (create/approve/publish) workflow and RBAC restricting who can modify production, directly satisfying the governance requirement. Missing for 10: explicit documentation tying the MCP/CLI agent path specifically to enforced approval gating (rather than just RBAC/Change Requests existing as a general feature), and independent/hands-on verification that agent-driven changes are actually blocked without approval.
